title: Onboarding Chart of Accounts Setup
brief: Prepare an initial chart of accounts table and map raw bank transactions into balanced journal entries.

delegate.scenario: You are onboarding Silverline Logistics, a regional freight brokerage client closing their first operational month. The senior accounting manager needs a structured chart of accounts and an initial general journal batch by 4:00 PM for month-end reconciliation. The mapped entries will serve as the opening ledger entries in QuickBooks Online.
delegate.inputs:
Client note from Jamal Cole (Silverline Logistics):
"Here are our bank transactions from our first month (October 2024). We use standard 4-digit GL coding (1000s Assets, 2000s Liabilities, 3000s Equity, 4000s Revenue, 5000s Cost of Goods/Freight, 6000s Operating Expenses)."

| Date | Description | Amount | Reference |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 10/02/2024 | Initial owner capital deposit | $50,000.00 | Wire 1042 |
| 10/05/2024 | Office lease - October | -$3,200.00 | ACH 8821 |
| 10/11/2024 | Shipper payment - Forwarder Corp | $14,800.00 | Wire 1055 |
| 10/14/2024 | Carrier dispatch settlement - Silverline Route 12 | -$8,400.00 | ACH 8840 |
| 10/18/2024 | Annual fleet liability insurance policy (12 mo) | -$6,000.00 | Debit 402 |
| 10/22/2024 | Shipper payment - Forwarder Corp | $14,800.00 | Wire 1055 |
| 10/29/2024 | Enterprise dispatch software subscription | -$850.00 | Debit 409 |
| 10/31/2024 | Dispatch fees receivable (billed, uncollected) | $9,200.00 | Inv 1004 |
delegate.goal: Deliver a standardized chart of accounts alongside balanced double-entry journal entries ready for the senior accountant's review.

criteria.text: Specifies the output is intended for the senior accounting manager onboarding a new client.
Requires a structured 4-digit chart of accounts defining account codes, account names, and account types.
Directs the AI to format transactions into standard general journal entry format with debit and credit columns.
Instructs the AI to verify whether every entry belongs in the cash bank ledger or represents a non-cash accrual.
Asks the AI to examine transaction details for potential duplicate records or multi-period prepayments requiring accrual treatment.

traps.description: Wire 1055 appears twice on 10/11/2024 and 10/22/2024 with identical descriptions and amounts, indicating an accidental duplicate paste in bank feed logs.
Inv 1004 is an uncollected accounts receivable billing entry included inside a list of settled bank cash transactions.
